workflow_runs.display_title: fix(eatsure): critical fixes for EatSure integration from audit report

head_commit.message:
fix(eatsure): critical fixes for EatSure integration from audit report

- eatsure.ts: Added getLoginDetectionScript and successUrlPattern to prevent crash on connect.
- eatsure.ts: Added 'all' to regions so it appears when no location is set.
- eatsure.ts: Fixed string interpolation (JSON.stringify) for locName and query.
- eatsure.ts: Fixed deduplication logic that was dropping actual dish cards.
- eatsure.ts: Fixed price regex to not capture discount values as dish price.
- eatsure.ts: Prevented standard menu discounts from being passed as phantom coupons.
- eatsure.ts: Handled EatSure dish name extraction avoiding badges like BESTSELLER.
- eatsure.ts: Reduced polling interval to 250ms and added isDispatched guard.
- App.tsx: Removed hardcoded 'food-a' (Swiggy) and 'food-b' (Zomato) fallbacks across carts/banners.
- App.tsx: Added 'eatsure' to restaurant name normalization to enable cross-platform merging.
- UniversalCartModal.tsx: Removed fake FLAT100/FLAT200 synthetic coupons injected on subtotals.
- LoginWebViewModal/PlatformBrowserModal: Removed hardcoded Medininagar fallback locations.

workflow_runs.name: Build Expo APK
workflow_runs.display_title: fix: exhaustive codebase audit fixes applied

head_commit.message:
fix: exhaustive codebase audit fixes applied

1. App.tsx:
- fetchCurrentLocation now sets isSearching=true
- Geocode fallback to Nominatim works if results is empty array
- NLP parsing improved to not overmatch 'in/at' prepositions for common dish words
- Dish substring merge issue fixed (removed simple .includes() in favor of strict word overlap)
- searchTimeout timer uses a clearable ref to prevent race conditions
- onError in WebView properly marks provider as completed
- Removed hardcoded 'Paneer Tikka' and 'Medininagar' fallback strings

2. WebViewExtractor.tsx:
- Empty hostname bug on initial load fixed (uses document.referrer and URL href)
- Safe string escaping with JSON.stringify for locationName

3. zomato.ts:
- Zomato DOM scrape timeout increased from 750ms to 6.25s so it actually has time to load cards

workflow_runs.name: Build Expo APK
workflow_runs.display_title: fix: stale closure + fake coupon/bank offers cleanup

head_commit.message:
fix: stale closure + fake coupon/bank offers cleanup

1. STALE CLOSURE BUG: fetchCurrentLocation and handleManualLocation
   referenced searchQuery/apiSearchQuery state directly inside async
   callbacks — these captured stale initial values (empty string).
   Fixed by adding searchQueryRef + apiSearchQueryRef and using .current
   in both async callbacks.

2. Swiggy: Hardcoded bank offer (HDFC/ICICI ₹100), UPI cashback (₹50),
   and Swiggy One free delivery injected into EVERY result regardless of
   what was real. Completely removed — only real coupon data from API is shown.

3. Zomato DOM scrape: 'ZOMATO50' hardcoded coupon code + 50% discount
   injected on every DOM-scraped restaurant. Replaced with empty/zero values.

4. Zomato DOM items: couponPercent:50, couponMaxCap:100 fallbacks removed.

workflow_runs.name: Build Expo APK
workflow_runs.display_title: fix: 5 more bugs found and fixed

head_commit.message:
fix: 5 more bugs found and fixed

1. Manual location set triggered isSearching=true without any query,
   causing WebViews to fire with activeQuery='paneer' (the hardcoded fallback).
   Fixed: only set isSearching/searchNonce on location change if there is
   an active query already.

2. GPS location auto-detect also unconditionally called setSearchNonce,
   same issue. Fixed with same guard.

3. activeQuery had hardcoded fallback 'paneer' — searches for paneer
   would randomly fire whenever location changed. Changed to empty string
   with an early return if no query.

4. Swiggy: couponCode || 'FEASTMODE' (fake coupon), couponPercent || 50,
   couponMaxCap || 100 — fabricated discount data when no real coupon found.
   Replaced with empty/zero defaults.

5. Zomato: same fake 50/100 coupon fallback + offerText showed '| Use '
   even when both couponDesc and couponCode were empty strings.
